subject: Discovery recap + two quick questions on fit
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Reeve <hannah@orbis.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + two quick questions on fit

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Short recap below (quick bullets) and two small asks so we can decide whether to proceed with a brief pilot.

What I heard from our call:
- Goal: reduce inference cost by ~30% on your nightly batch reruns while keeping tail-latency under 200ms for interactive widgets.
- Current infra: mixed CPU + occasional GPU; models are Llama-2 variants (~8B) with custom tokenization; KV usage is moderate.
- Success criteria: < $0.01/token effective cost for batch runs and <200ms 95th for interactive flows, plus zero customer-data retention longer than 7 days.

Suggested next steps (pick one):
1) 30-min technical scoping with Grace (solutions engineer) to confirm model compatibility and pilot success criteria; or
2) short pilot (2–3 week) focused on batch run optimization and a single widget latency test.

Two quick asks for you — would appreciate a one-line reply:
A) Is reducing cost+latency a top-3 infra priority for Orbis in the next 60 days? (yes / no / unscheduled)
B) If yes, which option above would you prefer? (technical scoping / pilot)

Attached: Discovery-notes-Orbis-20280614.pdf (notes + preliminary action plan).

If I don't hear back this week I'll send a very short ping on Monday — wanted to keep this easy.

Thanks,

Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Mateo / Grace —

Thanks for the follow-ups and for the clear recap. Quick update from our side: we ran this up to leadership and given a couple of competing infra investments we've decided to deprioritize inference optimization work until Q4.

That said, we're still interested in the pilot outline you shared — could you leave the one-pager with us and we may revisit in October. For now: A) priority: no (not in next 60 days); B) preference: pilot (but delayed).

Appreciate the time — keep us posted if you run any cost/latency benchmarks that look relevant to Llama-2 8B on mixed infra; I'll re-open the thread when the Q4 planning window opens.

Best,
